content: To the Buddhas Vipaśyin, Śikhin, and Viśvabhū,Krakucchanda, Kanakamuni, and Kāśyapa,To Śākyamuni Gautama, the god of gods,To the seven heroic Buddhas, I pay homage!In the past, for the sake of sentient beings,Whatever hardships I have undergone,And by the way I have surrendered my own happiness,May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!In the past, for the sake of those who were ill,I completely gave up my own livelihood;In order to protect destitute sentient beings,May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!By giving away my sons, daughters, and wives,Wealth, elephants, and chariots,I have given away for the sake of precious enlightenment;May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!By the offerings I have made to the Buddhas, Pratyekabuddhas,Śrāvakas, my father and mother,And to the sages,May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!For many tens of millions of eons, IHave experienced various kinds of suffering,And sought out the teachings for the sake of enlightenment;May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!Through my ethical discipline and spiritual vows,And by practicing austerities for a long time,I have made offerings to the Buddhas of the ten directions;May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!Because I possessed diligence in the past,I have been ever steadfast and overcome all opposition;For the sake of liberating all sentient beings,May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!I have constantly relied upon the ascetic practice of patience,And through my patience toward the harmful actions of sentient beings,Who are driven by the dregs of their afflictions,May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!Through my cultivation of the meditative concentrations, the liberations, the formless absorptions,And samādhis as numerous as the grains of sand in the Ganges,By the power of these meditations, may myTeachings blaze for a long time to come!For the sake of primordial wisdom, in the past,I relied upon the forests of asceticism,And by thoroughly studying many treatises,May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!Out of compassion, my flesh and blood,And my very life, I completely surrendered;Through the giving of my limbs and members,May the ways of the Dharma flourish and expand!Those who were previously sinful sentient beings,I have clearly brought to maturity through loving-kindness,And by establishing them in the three vehicles,May the sacrificial offering of the Dharma flourish!When I, in the past, became skillful means and wisdom,I liberated sentient beings from wrong views,And established them in the authentic view; through this,May the Dharma increase and expand!By means of the four ways of gathering disciples,I have liberated beings from the fire of the afflictions;Since I have defeated the proliferation of negativity,May my retinue remain for a very long time!Other non-Buddhist extremists,I have rescued from the waters of wrong views,And by establishing them in the authentic view,May I and my retinue always remain devoted!May the teachings blaze for a long time to come!May the Dharma traditions of the Dharma King TsongkhapaFlourish and expand,May the signs of obstacles be pacified,And may all favorable conditions be complete!By relying upon the two accumulationsConnected with myself and others throughout the three times,May the teachings of the Victorious Lobsang DrakpaBlaze for a long time to come!May the teachings, the sole source of benefit and happiness,Endure for a long time,And may the lives of the holy beings who uphold the teachingsBe as firm as a victory banner!
